newsitem.title: JAPAN: Pioneer to post special 6-month loss of 10 bln yen.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer to post special 6-month loss of 10 bln yen.

text.p: Pioneer Electronic Corp said on Thursday that it would incur a half-year parent special loss of 10.07 billion yen due to unexpectedly large payments for early retirement.

The loss for the six months to September 30 would be larger than the company's initial forecast of 7.2 billion yen, as 998 employees applied for a retirement programme against an original estimate of 650, a Pioneer spokesman said.
The company had planned to offset the 7.2 billion yen with profits from the sale of some of its shareholdings, he said.

But even with the unexpectedly high retirement payments, the company does not think there will be a major change in its current forecast of parent net loss of 12.4 billion yen for the half-year period, he said.
The company plans to announce its half-year earnings results on November 15.
